name: Hexagonal Prism Voxel Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that represents voxels as hexagonal prisms to reduce aliasing and provide smoother surfaces compared to cubic voxels, using a specific vertex layout for the hexagonal geometry.
summary: Hexagonal Prism Voxel Rendering replaces cubic voxels with hexagonal prisms to reduce aliasing and smooth surfaces, using instanced rendering for optimized performance.
